subject: api_contracts
summary: openapi/openapi.yaml GET /reservations/{holdId} (operationId getReservation) adequately elevates W2 named lookup failures at standard density: 400 HoldMissingOrNotVisible / PreconditionError and 403 UnauthorizedError carry first-class errorType examples with no stock/hold mutation MUST wording; missing and not-visible share one PreconditionError channel as planned; authorized 200 LookupResponse is retained and prior reserve/release/expire surfaces are not thinned. ErrorResponse.errorType prose now covers lookup. solidsdd-lint pass with zero findings. Remaining items are polish only.

findings.detail: Reusable UnauthorizedError (and InsufficientStockError) response components are defined but unused; getReservation documents the UnauthorizedError channel inline under 403. Polish only—named errorType enum and examples already make the failure distinguishable.

No-mutation side effects for missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup are stated in description/example prose rather than structured response fields; adequate at standard density with named errorType (OCL owns mutation posts).
